title: Resourceful Cacti
description: Turn you cactus farm into ultimate resource cacti farm!
body:
Have you ever looked at a growing cactus and thought to yourself "I wish I could grow resources like that"?

No? Well, then you're in the wrong place... but for people like me:

COME AND SEE THE ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES OF RESOURCEFUL CACTI!


![Cacti!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43655b801f19115f411923d0a08df889964737cc.png)

**New changes:**
1. Slight rework of tier system
2. Support for custom creation of resource cacti
3. More in the version changelog!

**How to start:**
1. Find yourself a cactus
2. Right click with shears on it to remove the spikes
3. Infuse all the spikes you got with coal block (right click on coal block) and you'll get yourself a coal spikes
4. Craft you first resource cactus!

Full compability with JEI, other similair mods might be missing recipies for spikes.

Mod is compatible with Utilitarian's snad, mekanism's ore processing and hopefuly more.



FAQ:

<summary>1. The mod has 0 downloads, why is there "Frequently Asked Questions" category?</summary>

That's mean but not incorrect observation, this section right now is mostly to answer question you might have

<details>
<summary>2. What are the future plans for this mod?</summary>

- Further balance based on player feedback,

- Possible re-texturing,

- In the far future - make the mod data driven, so each new cactus can be added via .json file - Don't know how to yet

</details>




<details>
<summary>3. Will you be updating this mod to newer version, adding it to forge/fabric etc?</summary>

In the future definetely, right now I'm trying to slowly add features, fix things etc. Once I'm happy with the outcome I'll start moving it to newer versions and different mod loaders.

</details>



<details>
<summary>4. Can I add your mod to my modpack?</summary>

Yes, absolutely but please do notify me that it's added to your modpack so I can check it out :)

Contact for inquiries: grodomirscactimod@gmail.com

</details>
